projects.title: Handwritten-Symbol Classification Under Input Changes
bullets: Trained a compact image classifier with Python and PyTorch using public handwritten-symbol images in a supervised undergraduate independent study.
Applied simple input transformations and summarized classification errors for the small-image classification study.

projects.title: Texture Image Classification Course Project
bullets: Loaded public small-image datasets from texture image collections as part of a supervised undergraduate course project.
Trained a compact image classifier using Python and PyTorch for the course project on small-image classification under input changes.

research.title: Test Coverage for Numerical Utility Libraries
bullets: Documented test failures and fixes in public numerical utility libraries as a student assistant in supervised faculty research.
Measured branch coverage for small open-source numerical utility libraries as part of the supervised test coverage study.

research.title: Natural-Scene Classification Under Input Changes
bullets: Applied simple input transformations to public natural-scene images as a student assistant in supervised faculty research.
Summarized classification errors for the supervised study of small-image classification under input changes.
